name: Americares
summary: A US health and disaster-relief charity that ships donated medicines and supplies to clinics and hospitals in the US and about 90 countries, runs drug companies' patient-assistance programmes for uninsured US patients, runs its own clinics in Colombia, El Salvador, India and Connecticut, and responds to disasters and crises with medicine, health care, water and cash.

lines.label: Medicine donations, the patient-assistance programme, Americares' clinics and community health projects
lines.source: https://www.americares.org/wp-content/uploads/2025-Americares-Foundation-UG.pdf (FY2025, year to 30 June 2025, consolidated statement of functional expenses p. 8): Access to Medicine $1,763,666k less donated goods distributed $1,729,225k = $34,441k, plus Clinical Services and Community Health $64,407k less $5,886k = $58,521k; two accounts lines, one model with branches (both direct-health). Cash only: donated goods are drug companies' resources and enter the models' credit shares, not the cost.

lines.label: Emergency programmes
lines.source: https://www.americares.org/wp-content/uploads/2025-Americares-Foundation-UG.pdf (FY2025, p. 8): Emergency Programs $50,546k less donated goods distributed $10,440k = $40,106k (cash only, as above).

spending.source: https://www.americares.org/wp-content/uploads/2025-Americares-Foundation-UG.pdf (FY2025, year to 30 June 2025, consolidated statement of activities p. 7): total program services $1,878,619k less distribution of donated medical and disaster supplies $1,745,551k = $133,068k of cash programme spending (the annual report's 'Total Program Services (without GIK)', p. 18). Donated goods, recorded at US wholesale acquisition cost, are the donors' resources and count in the models' credit shares, not here.
